source: Bird, P. (2003) An updated digital model of plate boundaries, G-Cubed 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252
note: Boundary runs merge consecutive PB2002 digitisation steps of the same boundary and class. v = mean relative velocity of the left plate w.r.t. the right plate (mm/a, model PB2002), div = mean divergent component (negative = convergence), rl = mean right-lateral component, weighted by step length.
